name: Vaelmere Trader's Overcoat
description: The Vaelmere-standard trader's overcoat — a practical blend of elven tailoring and realm-trader utility, designed for long Border transit and sustained cross-cultural work.
narrative_effects: Maintains warmth across Border crossings and realm-side travel.
Cut signals Vaelmere origin to realm traders who work regularly with the Feywood; a visual shortcut that smooths negotiations.
